descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
FULL THROTTLE. NEON TRACKS. NO BRAKES.

Battery in, props on, send it! DroneRush is pure arcade racing: screaming racing drones, glowing gates and a clock that shows no mercy.
Trigger for throttle, stick for steering, that's all it takes. You're racing within seconds, and hooked one lap later.

A RACETRACK ON YOUR TABLE
Switch to mixed reality and the whole neon circuit lands in your living room. Grab it, scale it, race on it.

BLAZING FAST
Hit the boost pads, thread the gates, shave off another tenth. Crashed? You're back in the air in a blink. One more run!

BEAT THE GHOST
The fastest pilot on the track flies right beside you. Catch them. Pass them. Take their spot.

OWN THE LEADERBOARD
Every track, every lap, the whole world. VR, phone and browser pilots all fight for the same top spot.

CALL OUT YOUR FRIENDS
Send a duel link and settle who is really faster.

PICK YOUR DRONE
Four drones, four ways to fly. Which one wins this track?

Arm your quad now!
